name: Sheps Canyon Recreation Area (Sheps South Campground)
waterfront_evidence: p3-578 split (2026-11-22): engine facID 59 site points (loop 197, 23-62) on Esri World_Imagery (WV02 2022-08-09, a drawdown summer; 0.22 m/px frames at hw 100-110 m centred mid-row and on the NE end) and USGS NAIP (older, higher pool, before the pads). One gravel spine road along the peninsula shore; GFP map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/sheps_canyon_cg.pdf (2024-03-15) puts the odd/even shore row 24, 26, 28, 30-33, 35, 37, 39, 41, 43, 45, 47, 50, 52, 54, 56, 59, 61 on the reservoir side and 23, 25, 27, 29, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 49, 51, 53, 55, 57, 58, 60, 62 inland. Measured from the shore-row pad ends: ~20-30 m to the vegetation/sand line that marks the high-water edge, and 45-62 m to the drawn-down 2022 water (35 ~45 m, 37 ~48, 39 ~47, 41 ~57, 43 ~54, 56 ~49, 59 ~54, 61 ~62). Between: open grass, a faint grassed two-track (the pre-campground shore road on NAIP), a broken line of single trees with 10-20 m gaps (denser clumps by 26-30 and a shrub mass by 45-50 and 54), then sand beach. No bluff: pads ~3 m above full pool 3,187 ft (Open-Meteo 974-975 m at the pads, 967 m at the water). Reservoirs measure to the high-water edge, so the shore row is lakefront; clearest at 35, 37, 39, 41 and 56; the inland row is a view. HELD AT LAKEVIEW 2026-11-22 (reviewer): the shore row measures lakefront only to the high-water edge (curation doc) while the kit's drawdown lessons (p3-551, p3-572) measure to the water; pending AWH's ruling, the same question as Hat Creek 96E-101E (15759). If AWH rules for the high-water edge, raise to lakefront with a caveat naming the shore row.
inclusion_evidence: p3-578 split (2026-11-22): https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=59 sitesHashMap loop 197 ('South Sheps'): 40 units 23-62, every one 'Back-In Campsite Nonelectric', ReservableOnline, active, $16, 'Max Length: 60, Max Width: 25'. GFP page https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/sheps-canyon-recreation-area/ '40 non-electrical campsites'; GFP map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/sheps_canyon_cg.pdf panel 'SHEPS SOUTH CAMPGROUND' draws 40 numbered pads on one road with vault toilets at the south end and by the NE boat ramp. Esri 2022 imagery shows gravel spur pads off the spine road; its own park road runs ~2.5 km south from the main area. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits.
note: Sheps Canyon Recreation Area's non-electric campground on a peninsula of Angostura Reservoir's west arm, about 2.5 km down its own park road south of the main Sheps Canyon loop: one gravel road with sites on both sides, the east-side row facing the reservoir across open grass and beach, the west-side row inland. Showers and the dump station are at the main loop; the horse camp sits between the two. --Claude

fees.note: No electric sites, so the statewide $7 electrical fee never applies. Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.
